description: This file defines the Role entity class, which models user roles with permissions in a Java-based application using JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: An entity representing a user role with associated permissions, supporting ORM via JPA annotations.

methods.name: Role(String name)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize Role with a specific name.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the role.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the role.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the role.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the role.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves the set of permissions associated with the role.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Assigns a set of permissions to the role.
